name: Ruins of Drakil’jin
shortDescription: An ancient Drakkari crypt in Grizzly Hills where the tablets used in Drakuru’s ritual are found.
body: An ancient Drakkari crypt in Grizzly Hills where the tablets used in Drakuru’s ritual are found. The associated theater scenes are original interpretive paintings, not surveyed maps or exact instance layouts. See docs/research/drakuru-visual-assets.json for area traits and resemblance gates.
